verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents generating new footage from reference media, but only to reproduce a person, not a visual style: a Photo Avatar animated from a single still image, a digital twin built from a 15-second video, and prompt-to-video that accepts 'file inputs' alongside style controls. Style control itself is documented only as preset choices (cinematic, handmade, retro), not as matching a supplied reference. missing for 10: documented style transfer or reference-style matching from a user-supplied video/image, clarity on what 'file inputs' do for style, hands-on or independent corroboration.
